home_subtitle: Section 1 练 · 词汇与写钦佩的人
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：教材帮认词汇（intelligent/talented/artistic/vehicles）、-ist/-ian 后缀，翻译帮练短文填空五词，练习帮做题过关。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：读爱因斯坦小传，写作帮学写钦佩的人三步（be born in → be talented in → change the way），课尾小结。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：词汇释义（intelligent/talented/artistic/vehicles）、短文填空（prehistoric/died out/a type of/Perhaps/completely）、-ist/-ian 后缀、写钦佩的人（be born in/be talented in/change the way/from an early age/learn to do/show talent）。Unit 1 Look it up! 主题，核心词 intelligent/talented/artistic/vehicles/prehistoric/completely/curiosity/scientific，短语 die out/a type of/be born in/be talented in/change the way/from an early age。

steps.title: 新课：Section 1 练
steps.teach_html:
广播站站长苏文开场：Section 1 的课文读完了，今天练三件事：词汇释义、短文填空、写钦佩的人。

写钦佩的人，主角是爱因斯坦：一个从小就对科学和数学好奇的孩子，后来成了最伟大的科学家之一。

steps.title: 教材帮：intelligent / talented / artistic
steps.teach_html:
三个词都说人“厉害”，意思不一样：

intelligent 聪明的：脑子好，学东西快。She is an intelligent girl.

talented 有天赋的：在某一方面天生擅长。He is a talented singer.

artistic 有艺术天赋的：画画、音乐方面厉害。She has artistic talent.

记住：intelligent 说脑子，talented 说天赋，artistic 说艺术。

steps.title: 教材帮：vehicles / died out / prehistoric
steps.teach_html:
vehicle n. 交通工具：A bus is a vehicle. 公共汽车是一种交通工具。

die out 灭绝：Dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago. 恐龙大约在 6600 万年前灭绝。讲过去的事，die 要变 died。

prehistoric adj. 史前的：pre-（在……之前）+ historic（历史的）。Dinosaurs are prehistoric animals.

steps.title: 教材帮：a type of / Perhaps / completely
steps.teach_html:
a type of 一种：= a kind of。Birds developed from a type of dinosaur.

perhaps adv. 也许；可能：= maybe。Perhaps it will rain.

completely adv. 完全地；彻底地：complete（完全的）+ -ly。I completely agree.

steps.title: 教材帮：-ist / -ian 表人
steps.teach_html:
名词后缀 -ist、-ian 加在词尾表示人：

science（科学）→ scientist（科学家）；music（音乐）→ musician（音乐家）；art（艺术）→ artist（艺术家）。

再记两个：piano（钢琴）→ pianist（钢琴家）；history（历史）→ historian（历史学家）。

steps.title: 翻译帮：短文填空怎么做
steps.teach_html:
短文填空三步：

第一步，通读整段，先弄懂短文在讲什么，再动手填。

第二步，看空前后的搭配：a ___ of 后面跟名词，___ animals 前面要形容词。

第三步，看时态，该变形的要变形：讲过去的事，die out 要写 died out。

steps.title: 写作帮：写钦佩的人六个表达
steps.teach_html:
写一个有才华的人，用这六个表达：

be born in 出生于……；be talented in 在……方面有天赋；change the way 改变……的方式。

from an early age 从很小的时候；learn to do 学会做某事；show talent 展现天赋。

steps.title: 写作帮：be born in 和 from an early age
steps.teach_html:
be born in + 地方 / 年份：Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879. 爱因斯坦 1879 年出生在德国。

from an early age 从很小的时候：From an early age, he showed a strong curiosity about science and maths. 从小，他就对科学和数学表现出强烈的好奇心。

curiosity n. 好奇心：a strong curiosity 强烈的好奇心。

steps.title: 写作帮：be talented in / show talent / change the way
steps.teach_html:
be talented in + 方面：He was extremely talented in physics. 他在物理方面极有天赋。

show talent 展现天赋：He truly showed his scientific talent. 他真正展现了自己的科学天赋。scientific adj. 科学的。

change the way + 从句：His theory of relativity changed the way we understand space and time. 他的相对论改变了我们理解时空的方式。

steps.title: 翻译帮：阅读材料——恐龙的新发现
steps.teach_html:
下面是一段自编短文，讲恐龙的新发现。读两遍，记住三个问题：哪些恐龙长着羽毛？恐龙和今天的什么动物是亲戚？恐龙真的完全消失了吗？

读的时候用扫描的方法：问题问什么，就到文章里找什么。

steps.title: 练习帮：intelligent 是什么意思

steps.stem: Which word is closest in meaning to “intelligent”?
steps.help: 想想 intelligent 的中文意思，再看哪个选项意思一样。
steps.explain: Intelligent means clever. intelligent 是“聪明的”，和 clever 意思最接近。

wrong_feedback.A: strong 是“强壮的”，说的是力气，不是聪明。
wrong_feedback.C: famous 是“有名的”，说的是名气，不是聪明。
wrong_feedback.D: quiet 是“安静的”，说的是性格，不是聪明。

steps.reading: Dinosaurs lived on Earth a very long time ago. They were prehistoric animals, and they came in many sizes. Some were as small as chickens, and some were as big as ten elephants. Many dinosaurs ate plants, but some ate meat. Scientists think dinosaurs are related to crocodiles and today's birds. Perhaps the most surprising thing is this: some dinosaurs had feathers. In the 1990s, researchers in China found dinosaurs with feathers. This discovery helped explain the connection between birds and dinosaurs. All the non-bird dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago, but dinosaurs did not disappear completely. They survived as birds. In one way, the dinosaurs never died out — they just became smaller. Today's ducks and chickens are not scary, but they are actually related to the huge T-Rex!

steps.explain: Dolphins are highly intelligent animals. 海豚是非常聪明的动物。

common_errors.say: 拼写注意：intelligent 是 i-n-t-e-l-l-i-g-e-n-t，中间是双 l。
smart 意思也对，但这道题要填课文里的词 intelligent。

steps.reading: Dinosaurs lived on Earth a very long time ago. They were prehistoric animals, and they came in many sizes. Some were as small as chickens, and some were as big as ten elephants. Many dinosaurs ate plants, but some ate meat. Scientists think dinosaurs are related to crocodiles and today's birds. Perhaps the most surprising thing is this: some dinosaurs had feathers. In the 1990s, researchers in China found dinosaurs with feathers. This discovery helped explain the connection between birds and dinosaurs. All the non-bird dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago, but dinosaurs did not disappear completely. They survived as birds. In one way, the dinosaurs never died out — they just became smaller. Today's ducks and chickens are not scary, but they are actually related to the huge T-Rex!

steps.title: 写作帮：写钦佩的人三步
steps.teach_html:
写钦佩的人，记住三步，顺序别乱：

第一步，be born in：写他出生在哪里、哪一年。Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879.

第二步，be talented in：写他在哪个方面有天赋。He was talented in physics.

第三步，change the way：写他改变了什么。His theory changed the way we understand space and time.

每句只写一件事：先写出生，再写天赋，最后写影响。

steps.explain: We usually start with his birth: when and where he was born. 写钦佩的人，第一句先写出生：哪一年出生在哪里。

wrong_feedback.A: his influence 是“他的影响”，这是第三步才写的东西。
wrong_feedback.B: his talent 是“他的天赋”，这是第二步才写的东西。
wrong_feedback.D: his hobby 是“他的爱好”，三步里没有这一步。

steps.title: 小结：词汇、填空、写人
steps.teach_html:
今天练了三件事：

词汇释义：intelligent、talented、artistic、vehicles；短文填空五词：prehistoric、died out、a type of、Perhaps、completely；后缀 -ist、-ian 表人。

下节课进 Section 2，学 some 和 any。
